name: Qrevo S Pro
measure_description: Whole dock + robot measured at the wall with a ThirdReality Gen3 plug (2 s / 3 W power reporting, 1 Wh energy counter) over Oct 20-23 2026 runs; activity energies cross-checked against the plug's energy counter. Activities come from the dock's dust_emptying, mop_washing and mop_drying switches and the robot's status and battery. Sub-profiles match the dock's mop wash temperature setting: high_temperature and room_temperature. Branch values are total wall power: 0.3 W with the robot away (dock alone), 2.0 W with the robot docked at 100%, and charging adds ~19 W on top of the docked 2.0 W. Robot label: model RRE0PEE, product ID QSP51-01 (US 120 V).
